request.text:
Task: lift the covered pan off the stove without losing the lid or the contents.
Scene: a pan with a long handle sits on a stove block; the handle points toward the robot. A lid rests on the pan. The pan
may contain food of unknown mass. Arms: L (on the handle side), R (can reach the far side). Each arm has a two-finger claw.

Skills (name(params): precondition -> effect):
  observe_pose(): pan on stove, nothing lifted -> pose_refined (smaller pose error)
  pinch(arm in {L,R}, part in {handle, lid}, frac): arm free, pan on stove -> held_<arm>_<part>
  push(dist): L holds the handle, R free, pan on stove -> overhang (far rim hangs over the stove edge)
  clamp_rim(): overhang, R free -> held_R_rim, lid_secured (R clamps lid + wall + bottom)
  probe_mass(): L holds the handle, R free, pan on stove -> mass_known (tip-up about the far rim)
  lift(): at least one arm holds a part of the pan -> lifted

State atoms you may use in "require": on_stove, free_L, free_R, held_L_handle, held_L_lid, held_R_handle, held_R_lid, held_R_rim, overhang, lid_secured, pose_refined, mass_known, lifted, and did_<skill> for every skill.
Parts: handle, lid.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing after it:
{"facts": {"lid_attached": true|false, "contents": "...", "contents_mass_kg": [lo, hi] (optional)},
  "constraints": [{"forbid": {"skill": "...", "<param>": "<value>"}, "why": "..."},
                  {"require": {"skill": "...", "atom": "..."}, "why": "..."}]}
request.system: You are the constraint writer for a two-arm robot planner. You never write plans. You look at the scene and write FACTS about the objects and hard CONSTRAINTS that rule out actions a careful person would never take. A separate physics checker decides what is safe; your constraints only prune the search. Write a constraint only when you are confident, give a one-line reason for each, and never invent numbers you cannot see.

texts: {"facts":{"lid_attached":false,"contents":"Unknown; the pan may contain food of unknown mass."},"constraints":[{"forbid":{"skill":"pinch","part":"lid"},"why":"The lid merely rests on the pan, so gripping it cannot safely support the pan or secure the contents."},{"forbid":{"skill":"probe_mass"},"why":"Tipping the pan about its rim could shift or spill unknown contents and dislodge the unattached lid."},{"require":{"skill":"pinch","atom":"pose_refined"},"why":"Refining the pose reduces the chance of a claw contacting the pan or lid incorrectly."},{"require":{"skill":"lift","atom":"held_L_handle"},"why":"The handle-side arm must support and control the pan during lifting."},{"require":{"skill":"lift","atom":"held_R_rim"},"why":"The far-side rim clamp supports the vessel while retaining the lid and contents."},{"require":{"skill":"lift","atom":"lid_secured"},"why":"The unattached lid must be secured before the pan leaves the stove."}]}
